channel.title: Handy Calcs pins
channel.description: Free calculators in English and Spanish.

item.title: Ruleta de nombres: gira y elige al azar (gratis)
item.description: Escribe nombres, gira la ruleta y obtén un ganador al azar y justo. Ideal para clases, rifas, sorteos y decidir quién empieza. Gratis.

item.title: How to Pay Off Credit Card Debt Faster: Avalanche vs. Snowball
item.description: Why minimum payments take so long, how much interest you really pay, and two proven ways to pay off credit cards faster: the avalanche and snowball methods. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Random Name Picker Wheel: Spin to Choose (Free)
item.description: Type names, spin the wheel and get a fair random winner. Great for classrooms, raffles, giveaways and deciding who goes first. Free.

item.title: The 50/30/20 Budget Rule Explained (With Real Examples)
item.description: How the 50/30/20 budget works: what counts as needs, wants and savings, examples at different incomes, and how to adjust it when rent takes too much. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.

item.title: Contador de palabras y caracteres en línea (gratis)
item.description: Cuenta palabras, caracteres (con y sin espacios), oraciones y párrafos mientras escribes, más el tiempo de lectura y las palabras más usadas. Gratis.

item.title: How Overtime Pay Is Calculated (Time and a Half Explained)
item.description: How overtime works in the US: who gets it, the 40-hour week rule, time and a half, daily overtime in some states, and examples you can check on your paycheck. Free guide with a calculator, no sign-up.
